# imisofts

> imisofts is a Dubai-based AI automation and outbound growth agency founded and run by Zeeshan Waheed. We build cold email infrastructure and B2B lead generation systems, TCPA-compliant AI voice agents and AI receptionists, white-label GoHighLevel SaaS, AI workflow automation, and Shopify and web applications for small and mid-sized businesses, agencies and founders, mainly in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia and the UAE.

Key facts:
- Website: https://imisofts.com. Founder and CEO: Zeeshan Waheed (https://imisofts.com/author/zeeshan-waheed/).
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with a remote team.
- Contact: growth@imisofts.com. Book a 30 minute call: https://cal.com/zeeshanwaheed/30min. Free audit: https://imisofts.com/free-audit.

- Content: 572 articles at https://imisofts.com/blog (newest 2026-09-27), including cold email law guides for 29 countries, daily AI and outbound news, tool comparisons and reviews. RSS: https://imisofts.com/feed.xml. Sitemap: https://imisofts.com/sitemap.xml.

## Cold email, cold calling and data law guides

Plain-language guides to the anti-spam, calling and data rules that apply to B2B outreach: one page per country for cold email (29 countries), plus cold calling, AI caller disclosure, list buying and web scraping. Each states the governing statute, the consent basis for business-to-business contact, identification and unsubscribe duties, the regulator and the penalties.

- [AI Caller Disclosure Laws by State: What Actually Binds a Business](https://imisofts.com/blog/ai-caller-disclosure-laws-by-state/): No US law makes a private business announce an AI on a consented sales call. Colorado's duty was repealed before it bit. What Utah, Maine and the TCPA require.
- [Cold Calling Laws in the UK: CTPS, AI Voices and the New Fine Ceiling](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-calling-laws-uk/): UK B2B cold calling is legal after TPS and CTPS screening, but AI voice calls need prior consent per three ICO fines. Since Feb 2026 the ceiling is 17.5m or 4%.
- [Cold Email Laws in Australia: Spam Act Guide (2026)](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-australia/): Complete Australian Spam Act compliance guide for cold email. Learn consent requirements, inferred consent for B2B, ACMA enforcement, penalties up to $2.2M/day.
- [Cold Email Laws in Austria: A Three-Email Sequence Has a Price](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-austria/): Austria is opt-in for every recipient, business or not. A court priced a three-step cold sequence at 600, 600 and 800 euro, and the ECG list is widely misread.
- [Cold Email Laws in Belgium: The info@ Exception Has a Catch](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-belgium/): Belgium exempts emails to impersonal company addresses, but named addresses need consent, the DPA rejected legitimate interest in 2025, and fines are now x10.
- [Cold Email Laws in Brazil: The First LGPD Fine Was a List](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-brazil/): Brazil has no anti-spam statute and the LGPD allows cold email under legitimate interest. But the first fine ANPD ever issued was over a contact list.
- [Cold Email Laws by Country: The 28-Country Comparison Table (2026)](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-by-country/): One table for cold email law in 28 countries: the statute, whether B2B email needs prior consent, the regulator and the maximum penalty, each row linked to the full guide.
- [Cold Email Laws in Canada: CASL Compliance Guide (2026)](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-canada/): Complete CASL compliance guide for cold email in Canada. Learn implied consent for B2B, express consent requirements, CAD $10M penalties, and practical outreach
- [Cold Email Laws in Denmark: Every Sending Domain Is a Separate Fine](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-denmark/): Denmark's spam ban covers companies and consumers alike, treats named and generic addresses the same, and its fine tariff counts each sending domain separately.
- [Cold Email Laws in France: CNIL & GDPR Guide (2026)](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-france/): Complete French GDPR and CNIL compliance guide for cold email. Learn legitimate interest for B2B, B2C consent mandate (August 2026), penalties up to 4% revenue.
- [Cold Email Laws in Germany: UWG & GDPR Guide (2026)](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-germany/): Complete guide to German cold email laws, UWG requirements, GDPR compliance, and legal workarounds for B2B outreach in 2026.
- [Cold Email Laws in Hong Kong: What the UEMO and PDPO Require](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-hong-kong/): Hong Kong allows cold email without consent under the UEMO, but the PDPO criminalises using personal data to send it. The split, penalties and B2B carve-out.
- [Cold Email Laws in India: IT Act & Email Regulations (2026)](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-india/): India cold email laws, IT Act Section 5, DND registry, IAMAI guidelines, and B2B outreach compliance for 2026.
- [Cold Email Laws in Ireland: Per-Email Fines, But Warned First](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-ireland/): Ireland allows 5,000 euro per email and 250,000 euro on indictment, yet the DPC's largest published penalty is 6,000 euro. The rules, the pattern, a checklist.
- [Cold Email Laws in Italy: Article 130 and the Garante (2026)](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-italy/): Cold email to Italy needs prior consent under Article 130 of the Privacy Code, and companies are covered too. Why the Garante lets you phone first, what the 2026 Lex Iuris decision actually fined...
- [Cold Email Laws in Japan: Opt-In, With One B2B Exception That Still Works](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-japan/): Japan has been opt-in since 2008, but Article 3 keeps a carve-out for published business addresses. What that allows, what it does not, and the penalties.
- [Cold Email Laws in Mexico: Your Email Has to Name the Regulator](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-mexico/): Mexico's cold email rule is not in its privacy law. It is in the consumer law, and Article 17 says your ad must carry PROFECO's own contact details too.
- [Cold Email Laws in the Netherlands: Article 11.7 and the GDPR (2026)](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-netherlands/): Cold email to the Netherlands requires provable prior consent under Article 11.7 Telecommunicatiewet, for businesses too.
- [Cold Email Laws New Zealand: A .nz Address Is Enough](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-new-zealand/): New Zealand's spam law tests the message, not the sender. Section 4(2)(f) says an address ending in .nz creates a New Zealand link, so a US sender is in scope.
- [Cold Email Laws in the Philippines: No Spam Act, One Big Trap](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-philippines/): The Philippines has no anti-spam law and its regulator has blessed cold email. But education counts as sensitive data there, and that breaks your basis.
- [Cold Email Laws in Qatar: Two Regimes, Opposite Defaults](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-qatar/): Qatar's mainland law demands prior consent before any marketing email, but firms inside the QFC follow an opt-out rule instead. Here is the full split.
- [Cold Email Laws Saudi Arabia: Everyone Cites the Wrong Law](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-saudi-arabia/): Saudi cold outreach is governed by a CST telecom regulation, not only the PDPL. Promotional messages are blocked by default, and consent inside a privacy policy does not count.
- [Cold Email Laws in Singapore: PDPA Guide (2026)](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-singapore/): Singapore PDPA cold email laws, opt-in/opt-out rules, DNC registry, and legal B2B outreach strategy for 2026.
- [Cold Email Laws in South Africa: Opt-In Only, One Ask Allowed](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-south-africa/): POPIA repealed South Africa's opt-out spam rule in 2021. Now it is one consent request, marketing only to a yes, and guessed email addresses count as evidence.
- [Cold Email Laws in South Korea: Two Exceptions, and Neither Is B2B](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-south-korea/): Korea's Network Act Article 50 allows just two exceptions to prior consent, and a published business address is not one. Fines, labels and the two year clock.
- [Cold Email Laws in Spain: LSSI Article 21 and the GDPR (2026)](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-spain/): Cold email to Spain needs prior express consent under LSSI Article 21, with no B2B exemption and no legitimate interest route.
- [Cold Email Laws in Sweden: GDPR & Marketing Act Guide (2026)](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-sweden/): Sweden cold email laws, GDPR compliance, EKMR marketing act, Nordic entry strategy, and 8% reply rate techniques.
- [Cold Email Laws in Switzerland: The Penalty Is Criminal](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-switzerland/): Switzerland files cold email under competition law, not privacy law. Article 3(1)(o) UCA sets three duties and Article 23 makes a wilful breach criminal.
- [Cold Email Laws in the UAE: What's Legal for B2B Outreach (2026)](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-uae/): UAE cold email regulations, TDRA rules, DPA compliance, and safe B2B outreach strategies for Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
- [Cold Email Laws in the UK: PECR Guide (2026)](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-united-kingdom/): Complete PECR and GDPR compliance guide for cold email in the UK. Learn B2B soft opt-in, corporate subscriber exceptions, ICO enforcement, penalties. 2026 legal
- [Cold Email Laws in the United States: CAN-SPAM Guide (2026)](https://imisofts.com/blog/cold-email-laws-united-states/): Complete CAN-SPAM compliance guide for cold email in the US. Learn requirements, penalties up to $51,744/email, and state-level laws. 2026 legal framework.
- [Do Cold Email Laws Apply to LinkedIn Messages? Read the Definitions](https://imisofts.com/blog/do-cold-email-laws-apply-to-linkedin-messages/): Read on 26 September 2026: four anti-spam regimes define the covered message by where it lands or how it is stored, which reaches a LinkedIn DM, and two US courts have read CAN-SPAM the same way.
- [Is AI Cold Calling Legal? Yes. Your Script Has Two Seconds.](https://imisofts.com/blog/is-ai-cold-calling-legal/): AI cold calling is legal in the United States, and no federal rule makes you announce that the caller is AI. The FCC classified AI generated voices as artificial voices in 2024, which puts your agent...
- [Is Buying B2B Email Lists Legal? Only One Country Bans the Purchase](https://imisofts.com/blog/is-buying-email-lists-legal/): Australia makes acquiring a harvested list an offence. The US regulates the message, the UK and Canada the consent, the EU the notice. One checklist for five.
- [Is Web Scraping Legal in 2026? US, EU and UK Rules for Lead Generation](https://imisofts.com/blog/is-web-scraping-legal/): Public scraping beats the CFAA, but scrapers keep losing on terms, fake accounts, the DMCA and GDPR Article 14. KASPR erased 160M contacts to end its case.

## Use of this content

AI assistants, search engines and agents may read, quote and cite these pages with attribution to imisofts (https://imisofts.com) and a link to the page cited. Prices and legal thresholds change; the page text states the date it was last checked.
